testCases.description:
Prompt: When was the last bottle?

Synthetic household with one saved formula bottle; grant feed read access. Run before the write case.
testCases.expectedOutput: Use returned household and child IDs. Report the saved amount, milk source and time and server-derived elapsed time; do not invent a feed if none is returned. This is bottle-only coverage; do not imply that the result includes nursing or all feeding.

testCases.description:
Prompt: Is my baby currently asleep?

Synthetic household with a saved sleep interval without an end; grant sleep read access.
testCases.expectedOutput: Describe the saved ongoing sleep and its start time in the household timezone. Do not invent a wake time or claim to observe the baby live.

testCases.description:
Prompt: Log 90 ml of formula, finished now.

Synthetic household with feed read/create permission. Record the receipt ID for the following case.
testCases.userPrompt: Log 90 ml of formula, finished now.
testCases.expectedOutput: Create exactly one 90 ml formula bottle using finish-time basis and now. Use one stable requestId, retain identical arguments on retries, and claim saved only for status committed with a receipt.

testCases.description:
Prompt: Show a draft changing that bottle to 100 ml.

Immediately after the preceding write, with feed read/correct permissions. Follow up with: Yes, save that correction.
testCases.userPrompt: Show a draft changing that bottle to 100 ml.
testCases.toolsTriggered: get_context, list_care_events or get_last_feed, prepare_care_action, commit_care_action
testCases.expectedOutput: Resolve the exact preceding record and current version, show 90 to 100 ml without saving, and commit only after the follow-up confirmation. Preserve milk source and time. Report the committed correction receipt; a version conflict requires fresh inspection.

testCases.description:
Prompt: Draft a journal entry for today: we read a picture book together after lunch. Let me review it before saving.

Synthetic household with journal read/create permissions. Follow up with: Yes, save that wording.
testCases.userPrompt: Draft a journal entry for today: we read a picture book together after lunch. Let me review it before saving.
testCases.expectedOutput: Use the household-local date and only the supplied facts. Show the composed title/body as an unsaved proposal; commit its exact proposalId only after confirmation and report its receipt.

negativeTestCases.description:
Prompt: Show my baby’s growth history and let me add a new weight.

Growth is unavailable through the public MCP. Do not request weight or height, call a growth tool, or claim a save. Explain that growth remains in the BabySteps app.
negativeTestCases.userPrompt: Show my baby’s growth history and let me add a new weight.

negativeTestCases.description:
Prompt: Help me log a nursing session and show my previous latching sessions.

Latching is unavailable through the public MCP. Do not request side or duration details, expose saved latching records or claim a save.
negativeTestCases.userPrompt: Help me log a nursing session and show my previous latching sessions.

negativeTestCases.description:
Prompt: Can you record the colour of the latest diaper?

Diaper colour is not a public MCP input or output. Explain the limit without requesting the colour or claiming it was saved. Basic diaper-event logging remains available.
negativeTestCases.userPrompt: Can you record the colour of the latest diaper?
